capture.zh: 在怀特星怀特矿场挑战德拉萨，打败获得德拉萨精元（孵化得拉比）。

strategy_notes.zh: 丽莎布布叶绿光束消强化，然后大招；或盖亚、魔焰猩猩100级轮班，战斗系/火系克制冰龙；消强后上哈莫雷特直接大招。

engine_notes: Very thin sourcing: only the 4399 2011 summary (70级, 消强化 then 大招) and a 4399 问答 dated 2011-03-24.
Innate boost implied by '叶绿光束消强化'; atk+2 assumed. HP 10000 is the daytime fight (7k7k 2011-03-28 and 2011-03-31); the 19:00-21:00 limited mode (HP 5000, weaker attacks) is not modelled.

skills: species 715's last four at or below Lv70. Only 双爪强化 is named (undated Baidu Baike Boss section citing 4399). Period reports describe a physical attacker that inflicts 衰弱 (7k7k 2011-03-31), which fits 浩劫之力 and 极寒龙刺爪; 寒冰龙息 is not named.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).

Not given stat-drop immunity, against the 2026-10-21 default: a 4399 问答 answer (2011-03-29) advises 先降他属性 and 卡鲁克斯 破甲, and the modern client's normal-mode list has no idx 1 (only 德拉萨-虚弱 has it). Weak evidence; open for the user.
source_note: 4399 SPT+BOSS全攻略 (2011-07): 德拉萨 70级, 叶绿光束消强化然后大招; 4399 问答 2011-03-24.
